title: Row of Charges on X-Axis Electric Field Visualization
full_prompt: Create a ManimGL scene named `RowOfChargesXAxis` that visualizes a row of charged particles positioned along the X-axis and their resulting electric field. Implement a custom `ChargedParticle` class inheriting from `Group` that encapsulates a `TrueDot` representing the particle, handles charge, mass, and tracks position/acceleration history. Implement helper functions `lorentz_force` and `points_to_particle_info` to calculate the electromagnetic forces and field vectors, taking into account retardation effects (using past positions and delays based on the speed of light `c`). The scene should display a sequence of positive and negative charges arranged linearly, and render the surrounding vector field dynamically using these custom physics calculations to avoid singularities near the charges.

common_failure_modes.pattern: Missing lorentz_force or points_to_particle_info helper functions
common_failure_modes.note: The scene relies on custom physics calculations for field vectors.

common_failure_modes.pattern: ManimCE vs ManimGL compatibility issues with TrueDot or Group
common_failure_modes.note: TrueDot and Group are specific to 3blue1brown's ManimGL fork.
